description.en: The best Poké Ball with the ultimate level of performance. With it, you will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.
description.zh_cn: 必定能捉到野生宝可梦的，性能最好的球。

description.en: An ultra-high-performance Poké Ball that provides a higher success rate for catching Pokémon than a Great Ball.
description.zh_cn: 比起超级球来更容易捉到宝可梦的，性能非常不错的球。

description.en: A good, high-performance Poké Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.
description.zh_cn: 比起精灵球来更容易捉到宝可梦的，性能还算不错的球。

description.en: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It's thrown like a ball at a Pokémon, comfortably encapsulating its target.
description.zh_cn: 用于投向野生宝可梦并将其捕捉的球。它是胶囊样式的。

description.en: A special Poké Ball that is used only in the Great Marsh. It is recognizable by the camouflage pattern decorating it.
description.zh_cn: 仅能在大湿地中使用的特殊的球。上面有迷彩花纹。

description.en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective when attempting to catch Water- or Bug-type Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉水属性和虫属性的宝可梦。

description.en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well when catching Pokémon that live underwater.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉生活在水世界里的宝可梦。

description.en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes more effective the lower the level of the wild Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。捕捉的野生宝可梦越弱，就会越容易捕捉。

description.en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on a Pokémon species that has been caught before.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉以前曾捉到过的宝可梦。

description.en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes progressively more effective the more turns that are taken in battle.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。回合数花费得越多，宝可梦就会越容易捕捉。

description.en: A particularly comfortable Poké Ball that makes a wild Pokémon quickly grow friendlier after being caught.
description.zh_cn: 住着十分惬意的球。捉到的野生宝可梦会变得容易和训练家亲密。

description.en: A somewhat rare Poké Ball that was made as a commemorative item used to celebrate an event of some sort.
description.zh_cn: 有点珍贵的球。特制出来的某种纪念品。

description.en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark places like caves.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地在夜晚或洞窟等阴暗的地方捕捉宝可梦。

description.en: A remedial Poké Ball that restores the HP of a Pokémon caught with it and eliminates any status conditions.
description.zh_cn: 有点温柔的球。能回复捉到的宝可梦的ＨＰ并治愈异常状态。

description.en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that has a more successful catch rate if used at the start of a wild encounter.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。如果战斗开始后立刻使用，就能很容易地捉到宝可梦。

description.en: A quite rare Poké Ball that has been crafted in order to commemorate a special occasion of some sort.
description.zh_cn: 相当珍贵的球。特制出来的某种纪念品。

description.en: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to an injured Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 喷雾式伤药。能让１只宝可梦回复２０ＨＰ。

description.en: A spray-type medicine for poisoning. It can be used once to lift the effects of being poisoned from a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的中毒状态。

description.en: A spray-type medicine for treating burns. It can be used once to heal a Pokémon suffering from a burn.
description.zh_cn: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的灼伤状态。

description.en: A spray-type medicine for freezing. It can be used once to defrost a Pokémon that has been frozen solid.
description.zh_cn: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的冰冻状态。

description.en: A spray-type medicine used against sleep. It can be used once to rouse a Pokémon from the clutches of sleep.
description.zh_cn: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的睡眠状态。

description.en: A spray-type medicine for paralysis. It can be used once to free a Pokémon that has been paralyzed.
description.zh_cn: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的麻痹状态。

description.en: A medicine that can be used to fully restore the HP of a single Pokémon and heal any status conditions it has.
description.zh_cn: 能回复１只宝可梦的所有ＨＰ并治愈所有异常状态。

description.en: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It will completely restore the max HP of a single Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 喷雾式伤药。能让１只宝可梦回复所有ＨＰ。

description.en: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 120 HP to an injured Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 喷雾式伤药。能让１只宝可梦回复１２０ＨＰ。

description.en: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 60 HP to an injured Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 喷雾式伤药。能让１只宝可梦回复６０ＨＰ。

description.en: A spray-type medicine that is broadly effective. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的所有异常状态。

description.en: A medicine that can revive fainted Pokémon. It also restores half of a fainted Pokémon's maximum HP.
description.zh_cn: 能让１只陷入濒死的宝可梦重获生机，并回复一半ＨＰ。

description.en: A medicine that can revive fainted Pokémon. It also fully restores a fainted Pokémon's maximum HP.
description.zh_cn: 能让１只陷入濒死的宝可梦重获生机，并回复所有ＨＰ。

description.en: Water with a high mineral content. When consumed, it restores up to 30 HP to an injured Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 富含矿物质的水。能让１只宝可梦回复３０ＨＰ。

description.en: A highly carbonated soda drink. When consumed, it restores up to 50 HP to an injured Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 翻腾着气泡的汽水。能让１只宝可梦回复５０ＨＰ。

description.en: A very sweet and refreshing drink. When consumed, it restores up to 70 HP to an injured Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 非常香甜的牛奶。能让１只宝可梦回复７０ＨＰ。

description.en: A bottle of highly nutritious milk. When consumed, it restores up to 100 HP to an injured Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 营养百分百的牛奶。能让１只宝可梦回复１００ＨＰ。

description.en: A very bitter medicinal powder. When consumed, it restores up to 60 HP to an injured Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 非常苦的药粉。能让１只宝可梦回复６０ＨＰ。

description.en: An extremely bitter medicinal root. When consumed, it restores up to 120 HP to an injured Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 非常苦的根。能让１只宝可梦回复１２０ＨＰ。

description.en: A very bitter medicinal powder. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 非常苦的药粉。能治愈１只宝可梦的所有异常状态。

description.en: A terribly bitter medicinal herb. It revives a fainted Pokémon and fully restores its maximum HP.
description.zh_cn: 非常苦的药草。能让１只濒死的宝可梦回复所有ＨＰ。

description.en: This medicine can restore 10 PP to a single selected move that has been learned by a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 能让宝可梦学会的其中１个招式回复１０ＰＰ。

description.en: This medicine can fully restore the PP of a single selected move that has been learned by a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 能让宝可梦学会的其中１个招式回复所有ＰＰ。

description.en: This medicine can restore 10 PP to each of the moves that have been learned by a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 能让宝可梦学会的４个招式各回复１０ＰＰ。

description.en: This medicine can fully restore the PP of all of the moves that have been learned by a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 能让宝可梦学会的４个招式回复所有ＰＰ。

description.en: Lavaridge Town's local specialty. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 釜炎特产的仙贝。能治愈１只宝可梦的所有异常状态。

description.en: A 100 percent pure juice made of Berries. When consumed, it restores 20 HP to an injured Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: １００％树果果汁。能让１只宝可梦回复２０ＨＰ。

description.en: This rare ash can revive all fainted Pokémon in a party. In doing so, it also fully restores their maximum HP.
description.zh_cn: 能让陷入濒死的全部宝可梦回复所有ＨＰ。

description.en: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the base HP of a single Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的ＨＰ的基础点数。

description.en: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the base Attack stat of a single Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的攻击的基础点数。

description.en: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the base Defense stat of a single Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的防御的基础点数。

description.en: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the base Speed stat of a single Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的速度的基础点数。

description.en: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the base Sp. Atk stat of a single Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的特攻的基础点数。

description.en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will instantly raise the level of a single Pokémon by one.
description.zh_cn: 充满能量的糖果。将它交给宝可梦后，１只宝可梦的等级仅会提高１。

description.en: A medicine that can slightly raise the maximum PP of a single move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 能让宝可梦学会的其中１个招式的ＰＰ最大值少量提高。

description.en: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the base Sp. Def stat of a single Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的特防的基础点数。

description.en: A medicine that can optimally raise the maximum PP of a single move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 能将宝可梦学会的其中１个招式的ＰＰ最大值提至最高。

description.en: The Old Chateau's hidden specialty. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 百代不为人知的特产。能治愈１只宝可梦的所有异常状态。

description.en: An item that prevents stat reduction among the Trainer's party Pokémon for five turns after it is used in battle.
description.zh_cn: 在战斗中，５回合内不让我方能力降低的道具。

description.en: An item that raises the critical-hit ratio greatly. It can be used only once and wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
description.zh_cn: 击中要害的几率会大幅提高。只能使用１次。离场后，效果便会消失。

description.en: An item that sharply boosts the Attack stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.
description.zh_cn: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦攻击的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

description.en: An item that sharply boosts the Defense stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.
description.zh_cn: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦防御的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

description.en: An item that sharply boosts the Speed stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.
description.zh_cn: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦速度的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

description.en: An item that sharply boosts the accuracy of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.
description.zh_cn: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦命中的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

description.en: An item that sharply boosts the Sp. Atk stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.
description.zh_cn: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦特攻的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

description.en: An item that sharply boosts the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.
description.zh_cn: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦特防的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

description.en: A doll that attracts the attention of a Pokémon. It guarantees escape from any battle with wild Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 能吸引宝可梦注意的道具。在和野生宝可梦的战斗中绝对可以逃走。

description.en: A toy that attracts the attention of a Pokémon. It guarantees escape from any battle with wild Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 能吸引宝可梦注意的道具。在和野生宝可梦的战斗中绝对可以逃走。

description.en: A flute made from blue glass that awakens sleeping Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 以蓝色玻璃制成的哨子。可以治愈睡眠状态。

description.en: A flute made from yellow glass that snaps Pokémon out of confusion.
description.zh_cn: 以黄色玻璃制成的哨子。可以治愈混乱状态。

description.en: A flute made from red glass that snaps Pokémon out of infatuation.
description.zh_cn: 以红色玻璃制成的哨子。可以治愈着迷状态。

description.en: A flute made from black glass. It makes it easier to encounter strong Pokémon in the place you use it.
description.zh_cn: 以黑色玻璃制成的哨子。在使用的地方更容易遇到强大的宝可梦。

description.en: A flute made from white glass. It makes it easier to encounter weak Pokémon in the place you use it.
description.zh_cn: 以白色玻璃制成的哨子。在使用的地方更容易遇到弱小的宝可梦。

description.en: Salt that you found inside Shoal Cave.
description.zh_cn: 在浅滩洞穴这地方找到的海盐。

description.en: A seashell that you found inside Shoal Cave.
description.zh_cn: 在浅滩洞穴这地方找到的贝壳。

description.en: A small red shard. It appears to be a fragment of some sort of implement made long ago.
description.zh_cn: 红色的小碎片。好像是以前制作的某道具的一部分。

description.en: A small blue shard. It appears to be a fragment of some sort of implement made long ago.
description.zh_cn: 蓝色的小碎片。好像是以前制作的某道具的一部分。

description.en: A small yellow shard. It appears to be a fragment of some sort of implement made long ago.
description.zh_cn: 黄色的小碎片。好像是以前制作的某道具的一部分。

description.en: A small green shard. It appears to be a fragment of some sort of implement made long ago.
description.zh_cn: 绿色的小碎片。好像是以前制作的某道具的一部分。

description.en: An item that prevents any low-level wild Pokémon from jumping out at you for a while. It lasts longer than Repel.
description.zh_cn: 弱小的野生宝可梦将完全不会出现。效果比除虫喷雾更持久。

description.en: An item that prevents any low-level wild Pokémon from jumping out at you for a while. It lasts longer than Super Repel.
description.zh_cn: 弱小的野生宝可梦将完全不会出现。效果比白银喷雾更持久。

description.en: A long and durable rope. Use it to escape instantly from a cave or a dungeon.
description.zh_cn: 结实的长绳。可以从洞窟或迷宫中脱身。

description.en: An item that prevents any low-level wild Pokémon from jumping out at you for a while.
description.zh_cn: 使用后，在较短的一段时间内，弱小的野生宝可梦将完全不会出现。

description.en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It burns as red as the evening sun.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像太阳一样赤红。

description.en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as black as the night sky.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像夜空一样乌黑。

description.en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. The stone has a fiery orange heart.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。看上去是橙黄色的。

description.en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a distinct thunderbolt pattern.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。有着闪电般的花纹。

description.en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is the blue of a pool of clear water.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。看上去是澄蓝色的。

description.en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。有着叶子般的花纹。

description.en: A very small and rare mushroom. It's popular with a certain class of collectors and sought out by them.
description.zh_cn: 珍稀的小蘑菇。在一些爱好者中有着相当高的人气。

description.en: A very large and rare mushroom. It's popular with a certain class of collectors and sought out by them.
description.zh_cn: 珍稀的大蘑菇。在一些爱好者中有着非常高的人气。

description.en: A rather small pearl that has a very nice silvery sheen to it. It can be sold cheaply to shops.
description.zh_cn: 散发着美丽银辉且有点小的珍珠。可以在商店低价出售。

description.en: A rather large pearl that has a very nice silvery sheen. It can be sold to shops for a high price.
description.zh_cn: 散发着美丽银辉且相当大颗的珍珠。可以在商店高价出售。

description.en: Lovely red sand that flows between the fingers with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a low price to shops.
description.zh_cn: 手感细腻且十分美丽的红色沙子。可以在商店低价出售。

description.en: A small shard of a beautiful gem that demonstrates a distinctly red sparkle. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
description.zh_cn: 闪着红光且十分美丽的宝石碎片。可以在商店高价出售。

description.en: A nugget of the purest gold that gives off a lustrous gleam in direct light. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
description.zh_cn: 闪着金光，以纯金制成的珠子。可以在商店高价出售。

description.en: A pretty, heart-shaped scale that is extremely rare. Some people are happy to receive one.
description.zh_cn: 有着美丽心形外形且非常珍稀的鳞片。有些人收到会很高兴。

description.en: A sweet honey with a lush aroma that attracts wild Pokémon when it is used in tall grass, in caves, or on special trees.
description.zh_cn: 在草丛或洞窟等地方使用后，被甜甜香气吸引的野生宝可梦就会出现。

description.en: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.
description.zh_cn: 培育树果时的肥料。但完全不适合丰缘地区的土壤，所以没什么效果。

description.en: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.
description.zh_cn: 培育树果时的肥料。但完全不适合丰缘地区的土壤，所以没什么效果。

description.en: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.
description.zh_cn: 培育树果时的肥料。但完全不适合丰缘地区的土壤，所以没什么效果。

description.en: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.
description.zh_cn: 培育树果时的肥料。但完全不适合丰缘地区的土壤，所以没什么效果。

description.en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived in the sea. It looks as if it could be part of a plant's root.
description.zh_cn: 很久以前栖息在海里的古代宝可梦的化石。好像是根的一部分。

description.en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived in the sea. It appears to be a fragment of a claw.
description.zh_cn: 很久以前栖息在海里的古代宝可梦的化石。好像是爪子的一部分。

description.en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived in the sea. It might be a piece of a seashell.
description.zh_cn: 很久以前栖息在海里的古代宝可梦的化石。好像是贝壳的一部分。

description.en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived in the sea. It could be a shell or carapace.
description.zh_cn: 很久以前栖息在海里的古代宝可梦的化石。好像是甲壳的一部分。

description.en: A piece of amber that still contains the genetic material of an ancient Pokémon. It's clear with a tawny, reddish tint.
description.zh_cn: 封存着古代宝可梦遗传基因的琥珀，透着点红色。

description.en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It looks to be from some kind of protective collar.
description.zh_cn: 很久以前生活在地上的古代宝可梦的化石。好像是领饰的一部分。

description.en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It appears as though it's part of a head.
description.zh_cn: 很久以前生活在地上的古代宝可梦的化石。好像是头部的一部分。

description.en: A rare bone that is extremely valuable for the study of Pokémon archeology. It can be sold for a high price to shops.
description.zh_cn: 在宝可梦考古学上非常贵重的骨头。可以在商店高价出售。

description.en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It shines with a dazzling light.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像光芒一样耀眼。

description.en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It holds shadows as dark as can be.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像黑夜一般漆黑。

description.en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It sparkles like a glittering eye.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像眼眸一般光彩动人。

description.en: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It's as round as a Pokémon Egg.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像珠子一般圆润。

description.en: A vital item that is needed to keep a stone tower from collapsing. Voices can be heard from it occasionally.
description.zh_cn: 没有它，石之塔就会崩塌的重要石头。有时能从石头里听到声音。

description.zh_cn: 只要携带它的宝可梦在战斗时出场一次，就能获得２倍金钱。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the head of the party.
description.zh_cn: 让排在最前面的宝可梦携带后，野生宝可梦就会不容易出现。

description.en: A wondrous orb to be held by either Latios or Latias. It raises the power of Psychic- and Dragon-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 让拉帝欧斯或拉帝亚斯携带后，超能力和龙属性的招式威力就会提高的神奇珠子。

description.en: An item to be held by Clamperl. This fang gleams a sharp silver and raises the holder's Sp. Atk stat.
description.zh_cn: 让珍珠贝携带后，特攻就会提高的牙齿。散发着闪亮的银光。

description.en: An item to be held by Clamperl. This scale shines with a faint pink and raises the holder's Sp. Def stat.
description.zh_cn: 让珍珠贝携带后，特防就会提高的鳞片。散发着淡淡的粉红色光芒。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to flee from any wild Pokémon encounter without fail.
description.zh_cn: 携带它的宝可梦在和野生宝可梦的战斗中绝对可以逃走。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A Pokémon holding this peculiar stone is prevented from evolving.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，宝可梦在此期间不会进化的神奇石头。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder may endure a potential KO attack, leaving it with just 1 HP.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，即便受到可能会导致濒死的招式，有时也能仅以１ＨＰ撑过去。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's an egg filled with happiness that earns extra Exp. Points in battle.
description.zh_cn: 满载着幸福的蛋。携带它的宝可梦获得的经验值会少量增加。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder's critical-hit ratio.
description.zh_cn: 能看见弱点的镜片。携带它的宝可梦的招式会变得容易击中要害。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a special metallic film that can boost the power of Steel-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 特殊的金属膜。携带后，钢属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder's HP is slowly but steadily restored throughout every battle.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，宝可梦的ＨＰ会在战斗期间缓缓回复。

description.en: A very tough and inflexible scale. Dragon-type Pokémon may be holding this item when caught.
description.zh_cn: 又硬又坚固的鳞片。龙属性宝可梦有时会携带它。

description.en: An item to be held by Pikachu. It's a puzzling orb that boosts its Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
description.zh_cn: 让皮卡丘携带后，攻击和特攻的威力就会提高的神奇之球。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a loose, silky sand that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 手感细腻的沙子。携带后，地面属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a durable stone that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 绝对不会裂开的石头。携带后，岩石属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a seed imbued with life force that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 孕育生命的种子。携带后，草属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A pair of shady-looking glasses that boost the power of Dark-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 看上去很奇怪的眼镜。携带后，恶属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This belt helps the wearer to focus and boosts the power of Fighting-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 能振作精神的带子。携带后，格斗属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a powerful magnet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 强力的磁铁。携带后，电属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This teardrop-shaped gem boosts the power of Water-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 水滴形状的宝石。携带后，水属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a long, sharp beak that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 又长又尖的鸟嘴。携带后，飞行属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This small, poisonous barb boosts the power of Poison-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 有毒的小针。携带后，毒属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a heat- repelling piece of ice that boosts the power of  Ice-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 能隔绝热量的冰。携带后，冰属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a sinister, eerie tag that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 古怪可怕的咒符。携带后，幽灵属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This spoon is imbued with telekinetic power and boosts Psychic-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 注入了念力的汤匙。携带后，超能力属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a combustible fuel that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 焚烧用的燃料。携带后，火属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This hard and sharp fang boosts the power of Dragon-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 坚硬锐利的牙齿。携带后，龙属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of Normal-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 手感不错的围巾。携带后，一般属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: A transparent device somehow filled with all sorts of data. It was produced by Silph Co.
description.zh_cn: 内部储存了各种信息的透明机器。西尔佛公司制造。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder regains a little HP every time it inflicts damage on others.
description.zh_cn: 当携带它的宝可梦攻击对手并造成伤害时，能回复少量ＨＰ。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This incense has a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 有着神奇香气的薰香。携带后，水属性的招式威力就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The beguiling aroma of this incense may cause attacks to miss its holder.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，薰香的神奇香气会迷惑对手，其招式会变得不容易命中。

description.en: An item to be held by Chansey. This pair of lucky boxing gloves will boost Chansey's critical-hit ratio.
description.zh_cn: 能带来幸运的拳套。让吉利蛋携带后，招式会变得容易击中要害。

description.en: An item to be held by Ditto. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Defense stat.
description.zh_cn: 让百变怪携带后，防御就会提高的神奇粉末。非常细腻坚硬。

description.en: An item to be held by Cubone or Marowak. It's a hard bone of some sort that boosts the Attack stat.
description.zh_cn: 某种坚硬的骨头。让卡拉卡拉或嘎啦嘎啦携带后，攻击就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by Farfetch'd. This very long and stiff stalk of leek boosts its critical-hit ratio.
description.zh_cn: 非常长且坚硬的茎。让大葱鸭携带后，招式会变得容易击中要害。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. During a contest, it raises the Cool aspect of the Pokémon holding it.
description.zh_cn: 携带它去参加华丽大赛的宝可梦会比平时看上去更加帅气。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. During a contest, it raises the Beauty aspect of the Pokémon holding it.

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. During a contest, it raises the Clever aspect of the Pokémon holding it.

description.zh_cn: 携带它去参加华丽大赛的宝可梦会比平时看上去更加强壮。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of moves.
description.zh_cn: 能放大观看物体的镜片。携带后，招式的命中率就会少量提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This headband exudes strength, slightly boosting the power of physical moves.
description.zh_cn: 力如泉涌的头带。携带后，物理招式的威力就会少量提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This thick pair of glasses slightly boosts the power of special moves.
description.zh_cn: 装着很厚镜片的眼镜。携带后，特殊招式的威力就会少量提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a well-worn belt that slightly boosts the power of supereffective moves.
description.zh_cn: 用惯了的黑色带子。携带后，效果绝佳时的招式威力就会少量提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Protective moves like Light Screen and Reflect will be effective longer.
description.zh_cn: 当携带它的宝可梦使出光墙或反射壁时，效果会比平时持续得更长。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves, but at the cost of some HP on each hit.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，虽然每次攻击时ＨＰ少量减少，但招式的威力会提高。

description.en: A single-use item to be held by a Pokémon. It allows the holder to immediately use a move that normally requires a turn to charge.
description.zh_cn: 携带它的宝可梦仅有１次机会可以在第１回合使出需要蓄力的招式。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a bizarre orb that will badly poison the holder during battle.
description.zh_cn: 触碰后会放出毒的神奇宝珠。携带后，在战斗时会变成剧毒状态。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a bizarre orb that will afflict the holder with a burn during battle.
description.zh_cn: 触碰后会放出热量的神奇宝珠。携带后，在战斗时会变成灼伤状态。

description.en: An item to be held by Ditto. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Speed stat.
description.zh_cn: 让百变怪携带后，速度就会提高的神奇粉末。非常细腻坚硬。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder has full HP, it will endure a potential KO attack with 1 HP. The item then disappears.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，在ＨＰ全满时，即便受到可能会导致濒死的招式，也能仅以１ＨＰ撑过去１次。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder moves after its target moves, its accuracy will be boosted.
description.zh_cn: 当携带它的宝可梦比对手行动迟缓时，招式会变得容易命中。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts moves used consecutively, but only until a different move is used.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，连续使出相同招式时，威力就会提高。不再使出相同招式时，威力就会复原。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It lowers Speed and allows Ground-type moves to hit Flying-type and levitating holders.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，速度会降低。飞行属性以及飘浮宝可梦会被地面招式击中。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is tremendously heavy and makes the holder move slower than usual.
description.zh_cn: 非常沉重的某种尾巴。携带后，行动会比平时更加迟缓。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder becomes infatuated, the opposing Pokémon will be, too.
description.zh_cn: 长长的鲜红色细线。携带后，在自己着迷时能让对手也着迷。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It gradually restores HP to Poison-type Pokémon. It damages any other type.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，毒属性的宝可梦会缓缓回复ＨＰ。其他属性的话，ＨＰ则会减少。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Hail when used by the holder.
description.zh_cn: 携带它的宝可梦使出冰雹的话，冰雹的时间就会比平时更长。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Sandstorm when used by the holder.
description.zh_cn: 携带它的宝可梦使出沙暴的话，沙暴的时间就会比平时更长。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Sunny Day when used by the holder.
description.zh_cn: 携带它的宝可梦使出大晴天的话，晴天的时间就会比平时更长。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Rain Dance when used by the holder.
description.zh_cn: 携带它的宝可梦使出求雨的话，下雨的时间就会比平时更长。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of multi-turn attacks like Bind and Wrap.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，绑紧以及紧束等会持续造成伤害的招式的回合数会增加。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious scarf boosts Speed but only allows the use of one move.
description.zh_cn: 有点讲究的围巾。虽然携带后速度会提高，但只能使出相同的招式。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It damages the holder every turn and may latch on to Pokémon that touch the holder.
description.zh_cn: 携带后，每回合都会受到伤害。有时也会附着到碰到自己的对手身上。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It reduces Speed but allows the holder's Attack stat to grow more after battling.

description.en: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It's loved by a certain Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 积蓄着庞大电气能量的箱子。某种宝可梦很喜欢它。

description.en: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It's loved by a certain Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 积蓄着庞大熔岩能量的箱子。某种宝可梦很喜欢它。

description.en: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.
description.zh_cn: 内部储存了奇怪信息的透明机器。制造者不明。

description.en: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. It's loved by a certain Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 蕴含着惊人强大灵力的布。某种宝可梦很喜欢它。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This sharply hooked claw increases the holder's critical-hit ratio.
description.zh_cn: 尖锐的爪子。携带后，招式会变得容易击中要害。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder successfully inflicts damage, the target may also flinch.
description.zh_cn: 尖锐的牙齿。携带后，在给予伤害时，有时会让对手畏缩。

description.en: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.
description.zh_cn: 激励自己，从而提高攻击和特攻。

description.en: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.
description.zh_cn: 用尖锐的巨爪劈开对手进行攻击。

description.en: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
description.zh_cn: 将神奇的念波实体化攻击对手。给予物理伤害。

description.en: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
description.zh_cn: 静心凝神，从而提高自己的特攻和特防。

description.en: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 放走对手，强制拉后备宝可梦上场。如果对手为野生宝可梦，战斗将直接结束。

description.en: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
description.zh_cn: 让对手陷入剧毒状态。随着回合的推进，中毒伤害会增加。

description.en: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.
description.zh_cn: 在５回合内一直降冰雹，除冰属性的宝可梦以外，给予其他宝可梦伤害。

description.en: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising both its Attack and Defense stats.
description.zh_cn: 使出全身力气绷紧肌肉，从而提高自己的攻击和防御。

description.en: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
description.zh_cn: 将特殊的毒液泼向对手。对处于中毒状态的对手，威力会变成２倍。

description.en: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.
description.zh_cn: 根据所使用招式的宝可梦，招式属性也会改变。

description.en: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. This also weakens the power of Water-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 在５回合内阳光变得强烈，从而提高火属性的招式威力。水属性的招式威力则降低。

description.en: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
description.zh_cn: 使对手愤怒。在３回合内让对手只能使出给予伤害的招式。

description.en: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.
description.zh_cn: 向对手发射冰冻光束进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。

description.en: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.
description.zh_cn: 将猛烈的暴风雪刮向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。

description.en: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.
description.zh_cn: 向对手发射强烈的光线进行攻击。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

description.en: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.
description.zh_cn: 在５回合内使用神奇的墙，减弱从对手那受到的特殊攻击的伤害。

description.en: Enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
description.zh_cn: 完全抵挡对手的攻击。连续使出则容易失败。

description.en: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 在５回合内一直降雨，从而提高水属性的招式威力。火属性的招式威力则降低。

description.en: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user's HP by up to half of its max HP.
description.zh_cn: 降到地面，使身体休息。回复自己最大ＨＰ的一半。

description.en: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.
description.zh_cn: 在５回合内被神奇的力量守护，从而不会陷入异常状态。

description.en: This full-power attack grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
description.zh_cn: 为了发泄不满而全力进行攻击。亲密度越低，威力越大。

description.en: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.
description.zh_cn: 第１回合收集满满的日光，第２回合发射光束进行攻击。

description.en: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when it's hit.
description.zh_cn: 扔石头或炮弹，攻击飞行的对手。对手会被击落，掉到地面。

description.en: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
description.zh_cn: 向对手发出强力电击进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

description.en: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
description.zh_cn: 向对手劈下暴雷进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

description.en: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
description.zh_cn: 利用地震的冲击，攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。

description.en: This full-power attack grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
description.zh_cn: 为了训练家而全力攻击对手。亲密度越高，威力越大。

description.en: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
description.zh_cn: 吸取血液攻击对手。可以回复给予对手伤害的一半ＨＰ。

description.en: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
description.zh_cn: 向对手发送强大的念力进行攻击。有时会降低对手的特防。

description.en: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
description.zh_cn: 投掷一团黑影进行攻击。有时会降低对手的特防。

description.en: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
description.zh_cn: 将手刀猛烈地挥下攻击对手。还可以破坏光墙和反射壁等。

description.en: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
description.zh_cn: 通过快速移动来制造分身，扰乱对手，从而提高闪避率。

description.en: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.
description.zh_cn: 在５回合内使用神奇的墙，减弱从对手那受到的物理攻击的伤害。

description.en: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those hit.
description.zh_cn: 用污泥波攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。有时会陷入中毒状态。

description.en: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
description.zh_cn: 向对手发射烈焰进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

description.en: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.
description.zh_cn: 用污泥投掷对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

description.en: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types. Raises the Sp. Def of Rock types.
description.zh_cn: 在５回合内，除岩石、地面和钢属性以外的宝可梦，都会受到伤害。岩石属性的特防还会提高。

description.en: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
description.zh_cn: 用大字的火焰烧尽对手。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

description.en: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by preventing its movement.
description.zh_cn: 投掷岩石进行攻击。封住对手的行动，从而降低速度。

description.en: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.
description.zh_cn: 以敏捷的动作戏弄对手后进行切斩。攻击必定会命中。

description.en: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
description.zh_cn: 向对手无理取闹，令其不能连续２次使出相同招式。

description.en: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned or burned, or if it has paralysis.
description.zh_cn: 当自己处于中毒、麻痹、灼伤状态时，向对手使出此招式的话，威力会变成２倍。

description.en: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks. Then, building up more power, the user raises its Speed stat.
description.zh_cn: 将火焰围绕身体攻击对手。积蓄力量并提高自己的速度。

description.en: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and heals any status conditions.
description.zh_cn: 连续睡上２回合。回复自己的全部ＨＰ以及治愈所有异常状态。

description.en: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.
description.zh_cn: ♂诱惑♀或♀诱惑♂，让对手着迷。对手将很难使出招式。

description.en: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.
description.zh_cn: 攻击的同时盗取道具。当自己携带道具时，不会去盗取。

description.en: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.
description.zh_cn: 以敏捷的动作瞄准对手的脚进行攻击。降低对手的速度。

description.en: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.
description.zh_cn: 用歌声攻击对手。同伴还可以接着使出轮唱招式，威力也会提高。

description.en: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, its power is increased.
description.zh_cn: 用回声攻击对手。如果每回合都有宝可梦接着使用该招式，威力就会提高。

description.en: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
description.zh_cn: 使出全部力量攻击对手。使用之后会因为反作用力，自己的特攻大幅降低。

description.en: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also raise the user's Defense stat.
description.zh_cn: 用坚硬的翅膀敲打对手进行攻击。有时会提高自己的防御。

description.en: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def.
description.zh_cn: 提高气势，释放出全部力量。有时会降低对手的特防。

description.en: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def.
description.zh_cn: 发射从自然收集的生命力量。有时会降低对手的特防。

description.en: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
description.zh_cn: 对手的ＨＰ至少会留下１ＨＰ，如此般手下留情地攻击。

description.en: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
description.zh_cn: 向对手喷射煮得翻滚的开水进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

description.en: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.
description.zh_cn: 快速投掷携带的道具进行攻击。根据道具不同，威力和效果会改变。

description.en: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.
description.zh_cn: 向对手发射电击光束。由于蓄满电流，有时会提高自己的特攻。

description.en: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.
description.zh_cn: 将带走的对手在第２回合从空中摔下进行攻击。被带到空中的对手不能动弹。

description.en: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
description.zh_cn: 用自己的身体狂舞挥打，给予对手伤害。

description.en: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
description.zh_cn: 压制对手，从而将其行动顺序放到最后。

description.en: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.
description.zh_cn: 放出怪异的火焰，从而让对手陷入灼伤状态。

description.en: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.
description.zh_cn: 轻巧地攻击对手。自己没有携带道具时，会给予较大的伤害。

description.en: This move prevents the target from using its held item for five turns. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.
description.zh_cn: 让对手在５回合内不能使用宝可梦携带的道具。训练家也不能给那只宝可梦使用道具。

description.en: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
description.zh_cn: 引发大爆炸，攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。使用后自己会陷入濒死。

description.en: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.
description.zh_cn: 以影子做成的锐爪，劈开对手。容易击中要害。

description.en: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.
description.zh_cn: 蓄力攻击。如果能在对手之后攻击，招式的威力会变成２倍。

description.en: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. The attack never misses.
description.zh_cn: 用尖尖的角刺入对手进行攻击。攻击必定会命中。

description.en: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.
description.zh_cn: 使出自己浑身力量突击对手。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

description.en: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This can sharply raise the Speed stat.
description.zh_cn: 打磨自己的身体，减少空气阻力。可以大幅提高自己的速度。

description.en: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.
description.zh_cn: 在５回合内减弱物理和特殊的伤害。只有冰雹时才能使出。

description.en: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.
description.zh_cn: 用尖尖的岩石刺入对手进行攻击。容易击中要害。

description.en: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
description.zh_cn: 在攻击之后急速返回，和后备宝可梦进行替换。

description.en: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.
description.zh_cn: 向对手发出微弱的电击，从而让对手陷入麻痹状态。

description.en: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move's power.
description.zh_cn: 让身体高速旋转并撞击对手。速度比对手越慢，威力越大。

description.en: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user's Attack stat.
description.zh_cn: 激烈地跳起战舞提高气势。大幅提高自己的攻击。

description.en: The user soars and then strikes its target on the next turn.
description.zh_cn: 第１回合飞上天空，第２回合攻击对手。

description.en: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
description.zh_cn: 向自己施以自我暗示，将能力变化的状态变得和对手一样。

description.en: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stat of those hit.
description.zh_cn: 用力踩踏地面并攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。降低对方的速度。

description.en: The user blows its cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.
description.zh_cn: 将冰冷的气息吹向对手进行攻击。必定会击中要害。

description.en: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.
description.zh_cn: 将大岩石猛烈地撞向对手进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

description.en: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.
description.zh_cn: 将镰刀或爪子像剪刀般地交叉，顺势劈开对手。

description.en: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 弹飞对手，强制拉后备宝可梦上场。如果对手为野生宝可梦，战斗将直接结束。

description.en: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.
description.zh_cn: 在４～５回合内死缠烂打地进行攻击。在此期间对手将无法逃走。

description.en: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.
description.zh_cn: 用带毒的触手或手臂刺入对手。有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

description.en: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal its own HP.
description.zh_cn: 吃掉正在睡觉的对手的梦进行攻击。回复对手所受到伤害的一半ＨＰ。

description.en: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
description.zh_cn: 用草缠住并绊倒对手。对手越重，威力越大。

description.en: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.
description.zh_cn: 激怒对手，使其混乱。因为愤怒，对手的攻击会大幅提高。

description.en: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
description.zh_cn: 从自己已学会的招式中任意使出１个。只能在自己睡觉时使用。

description.en: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
description.zh_cn: 在攻击之后急速返回，和后备宝可梦进行替换。

description.en: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.
description.zh_cn: 削减少许自己的ＨＰ，制造分身。分身将成为自己的替身。

description.en: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
description.zh_cn: 将身体的光芒聚集在一点释放出去。有时会降低对手的特防。

description.en: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
description.zh_cn: 制造出离奇的空间。在５回合内速度慢的宝可梦可以先行动。

description.en: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. This can also be used to cut down thin trees.
description.zh_cn: 用镰刀或爪子等切斩对手进行攻击。还可以切断细的树木。

description.en: The user soars and then strikes its target on the next turn. This can also be used to fly to any familiar town.
description.zh_cn: 第１回合飞上天空，第２回合攻击对手。还可以飞到去过的城镇。

description.en: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
description.zh_cn: 利用大浪攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。

description.en: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. This can also be used to move heavy boulders.
description.zh_cn: 使出浑身力气殴打对手进行攻击。还可以推动沉重的岩石。

description.en: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. This can also be used to climb a waterfall.
description.zh_cn: 以惊人的气势扑向对手。有时会使对手畏缩。还可以游泳登上瀑布。

description.en: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target's Defense stat. This move can also shatter rocks in the field.
description.zh_cn: 用拳头进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。还可以击碎岩石。

description.en: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground in the Sinnoh region.
description.zh_cn: 装着有助于探险且方便使用的道具的袋子。有了它就可以进入地下通道。

description.en: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry any treasures or loot obtained in the coal mine.
description.zh_cn: 结实的大袋子。可以将在煤矿里获得的宝物放进去。

description.en: It lists the rules for holding battles. For Link Battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.
description.zh_cn: 写着对战规则。在进行连接对战时，可以选择规则。

description.en: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in the tall grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.
description.zh_cn: 能够将藏在草丛里的宝可梦找出来的道具。走路就能给电池充电。

description.en: A card that lists how many Battle Points you have earned.
description.zh_cn: 可以查看赢得的对战点数的卡片。

description.en: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.
description.zh_cn: 记录着到现在为止的冒险经历的笔记。

description.en: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the exteriors of Poké Balls.
description.zh_cn: 放有贴在球壳上的贴纸的容器。

description.en: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.
description.zh_cn: 漂亮精美的盒子。可以存放宝可梦出演音乐剧时用来装扮自己的多种小物件。

description.en: A tiny bag that can hold 10 Seals for decorating Poké Balls.
description.zh_cn: 可以放入１０张贴纸的小袋子。

description.en: A convenient notepad that is used to register your Friends and friend codes and keep a record of your gameplay.
description.zh_cn: 使用方便的手册。可以添加朋友或记录游戏的内容。

description.en: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.
description.zh_cn: 用来打开或关闭山谷发电厂大门的大钥匙。不知为何，它落入了银河队的手中。

description.en: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.
description.zh_cn: 要交给神和镇上长老的远古护符。由宝可梦的骨头制成。

description.en: A card key for disengaging the security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.
description.zh_cn: 用于解除银河队本部安全防范系统的钥匙卡。弄丢了的话，好像会受到惩罚。

description.en: A mythical chain that is said to link the Legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.
description.zh_cn: 神话道具。据说连接着孕育出神奥地区的传说的宝可梦。

description.en: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows you your present location in the region.
description.zh_cn: 可以随时轻松查看的便利地图。也能清楚自己的位置。

description.en: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.
description.zh_cn: 会告诉你想对战的训练家在哪里的机器。走路就能给电池充电。

description.en: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It can hold up to 50,000 coins.
description.zh_cn: 可以存放代币的盒子。最多能放入５００００枚在游戏城获得的代币。

description.en: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 又破又旧的钓竿。在有水的地方使用的话，可以钓到宝可梦。

description.en: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 不错的新钓竿。在有水的地方使用的话，可以钓到宝可梦。

description.en: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 最新的厉害钓竿。在有水的地方使用的话，可以钓到宝可梦。

description.en: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in good, soft soil.
description.zh_cn: 浇水的道具。能让埋在松软土壤里的树果快快长大。

description.en: A case for storing Poffins cooked from Berries.
description.zh_cn: 用来保存烹饪好的宝芬的容器。

description.en: A folding Bike that enables a rider to get around much faster than with Running Shoes.
description.zh_cn: 能比跑步鞋跑得还快的折叠式自行车。

description.en: A key to one of the suites at a certain luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.
description.zh_cn: 湖畔高级宾馆的房间钥匙。不知为何，它经常会丢失。

description.en: A letter from Professor Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Route 224.
description.zh_cn: 大木博士的来信。上面写着请来２２４号道路。

description.en: A feather that glows like the moon. It's said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.
description.zh_cn: 散发着月辉般光芒的羽毛。据说隐藏着可以驱散恶梦的力量。

description.en: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.
description.zh_cn: 可以进入水脉市旅馆的卡片。不知为何，上面刻有５０年前左右的日期。

description.en: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. No one knows who made it.
description.zh_cn: 能发出响彻云霄的天籁之音的笛子。不知道是谁在什么时候制造的它。

description.en: A ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on its front.
description.zh_cn: 乘坐高速船水流号时所需的船票。上面绘有船的图案。

description.en: A pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on its front.
description.zh_cn: 拿着它就可以参加宝可梦华丽大赛。上面印有纪念奖章。

description.en: A stone formed by boulders melting in intensely hot magma, then hardening. Magma remains sealed inside it.
description.zh_cn: 被灼热熔岩熔化的岩石凝固后形成的产物。里面还留有熔岩。

description.en: A parcel entrusted into your care. You're supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.
description.zh_cn: 这是别人托付给你的包裹。需要将它交给从双叶镇启程踏上旅途的青梅竹马。

description.en: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.
description.zh_cn: 获取宝可梦手表，简称宝可表时所需的兑换券。需要３张。

description.en: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.
description.zh_cn: 获取宝可梦手表，简称宝可表时所需的兑换券。需要３张。

description.en: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.
description.zh_cn: 获取宝可梦手表，简称宝可表时所需的兑换券。需要３张。

description.en: The key to Team Galactic's sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.
description.zh_cn: 用于进入银河队在帷幕市市郊的可疑仓库的钥匙。

description.en: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.
description.zh_cn: 在湛蓝市的药店里得到的，能让任何宝可梦立刻变得精力充沛的高效药。

description.en: An amazing device that can record a battle between friends or the battles at certain special battle facilities.
description.zh_cn: 很酷的机器。可以记录和朋友或在特殊设施里的对战过程。

description.en: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.
description.zh_cn: 在生日或纪念日等日子里，为了表达感激之情，有时会将其扎成花束送出。

description.en: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electronic signal to open a door.
description.zh_cn: 在特定的地方使用，就会发出特殊电信号来开门的高科技钥匙。

description.en: A handy box where you can store up to 99 of each kind of Apricorn.
description.zh_cn: 使用方便，可以保存９９个球果的容器。

description.en: A report of all the discovered kinds of Unown.
description.zh_cn: 记录着已找到的未知图腾样子的笔记本。

description.en: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.
description.zh_cn: 可以随时轻松培育树果的便携式栽培容器。

description.en: This high-tech machine shows the location of invisible items. It's attached to the head when in use.
description.zh_cn: 会对看不见的道具起反应，并将它的位置告诉你的最尖端机器。戴在头上使用。

description.en: A card to save points for the Buena's Password show.
description.zh_cn: 可以将《葵妍的密语》这节目的点数积攒起来的卡片。

description.en: A very tasty tail of something. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
description.zh_cn: 非常美味的某种尾巴。可以在商店高价出售。

description.en: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound.
description.zh_cn: 能发出静心宁神音色的，非常古旧的铃铛。

description.en: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.
description.zh_cn: 用来打开电台卷帘门的卡片式钥匙。

description.en: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.
description.zh_cn: 用来打开满金地道大门的钥匙。

description.en: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.
description.zh_cn: 浇水的道具。能让树果种植盆里的树果快快长大。

description.en: A scale from a red Gyarados. It glows red like a flame.
description.zh_cn: 在愤怒之湖里出现的红色暴鲤龙的鳞片。散发着像火一样的红色光芒。

description.en: The Mime Jr. doll that was lost by the Copycat.
description.zh_cn: 模仿少女丢失的魔尼尼人偶。

description.en: A pass required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows you to ride whenever and however much you'd like.
description.zh_cn: 乘坐磁浮列车时所需的车票。可以随时自由乘坐。

description.en: An important part of a machine that was stolen from the Power Plant.
description.zh_cn: 发电厂里被盗的，用于发电机的重要零件。

description.en: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.
description.zh_cn: 散发着银色光辉的神奇羽毛。

description.en: A mystical rainbow feather that sparkles.
description.zh_cn: 散发着虹色光辉的神奇羽毛。

description.en: A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokémon. What is in the Egg is unknown.
description.zh_cn: 从宝可梦爷爷那里得到的有着神奇花纹的蛋。不知道是什么的蛋。

description.en: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.
description.zh_cn: 红色的球果。有种刺鼻的气味。

description.en: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.
description.zh_cn: 蓝色的球果。略有一股青草的香味。

description.en: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.
description.zh_cn: 黄色的球果。有种清爽的香味。

description.en: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.
description.zh_cn: 绿色的球果。有种焦香的香味，非常神奇。

description.en: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.
description.zh_cn: 粉红色的球果。有种甜甜的，好闻的香味。

description.en: A white Apricorn. It doesn't smell like anything.
description.zh_cn: 白色的球果。没有任何气味。

description.en: A black Apricorn. It has a scent beyond one's experience.
description.zh_cn: 黑色的球果。有种无法形容的气味。

description.en: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon that are usually very quick to run away.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉逃跑速度很快的宝可梦。

description.en: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon that are at a lower level than your own Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。要捕捉的宝可梦比自己宝可梦的等级越低，就会越容易捕捉。

description.en: A Poké Ball that is good for catching Pokémon that you reel in with a rod while out fishing.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉用钓竿钓上来的宝可梦。

description.en: A Poké Ball that is better than usual at catching very heavy Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉身体沉重的宝可梦。

description.en: A Poké Ball that works best when catching a Pokémon that is of the opposite gender of your Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉和自己宝可梦性别不同的宝可梦。

description.en: A strange Poké Ball that will make the wild Pokémon caught with it more friendly toward you immediately.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。捉到的野生宝可梦会立刻变得和训练家亲密起来。

description.en: A Poké Ball that will make it easier to catch Pokémon that can evolve using a Moon Stone.
description.zh_cn: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉使用月之石进化的宝可梦。

description.en: A special Poké Ball that is used during the Bug-Catching Contest.
description.zh_cn: 在捕虫大赛上使用的特殊的球。

description.en: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.
description.zh_cn: 在伙伴公园里使用的特殊的球。

description.en: A nice photo album for storing all the photos taken along your adventure.
description.zh_cn: 用来摆放在冒险中拍摄的纪念相片的相册。

description.en: A music player that allows you to listen to nostalgic songs. It's operated with the flip of a single switch.
description.zh_cn: 可以听到怀旧歌曲的音乐播放器。可用一个开关切换歌曲。

description.en: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound.
description.zh_cn: 能发出静心宁神音色的，非常古旧的铃铛。

description.en: Mahogany Town's famous candy. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 卡吉镇特产的馒头。能治愈１只宝可梦的所有异常状态。

description.en: A shiny green orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It's known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
description.zh_cn: 散发着绿色光辉的宝珠。据说和丰缘地区的传说渊源颇深。

description.en: A sturdy Capsule that can only be opened with a special key.
description.zh_cn: 需用特殊钥匙打开的坚固的容器。

description.en: A shiny red orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It's known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
description.zh_cn: 散发着红色光辉的宝珠。据说和丰缘地区的传说渊源颇深。

description.en: A shiny blue orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It's known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
description.zh_cn: 散发着蓝色光辉的宝珠。据说和丰缘地区的传说渊源颇深。

description.en: A crystal ball that was excavated from the ground. It's a very beautiful stone that is covered with bits of rock and earth.
description.zh_cn: 从地下挖出的水晶球。虽然表面覆盖着岩石和尘土，但非常漂亮。

description.en: A mysterious scale that causes a certain Pokémon to evolve. It shines in rainbow colors.
description.zh_cn: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇鳞片。散发着虹色光辉。

description.en: A mysterious Evolutionary lump. When held by a Pokémon that can still evolve, it raises both Defense and Sp. Def.
description.zh_cn: 进化的神奇石块。携带后，还能进化的宝可梦的防御和特防就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This very light stone reduces the weight of a Pokémon when held.
description.zh_cn: 非常轻的石头。携带后，宝可梦的体重会变轻。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is hit, the attacker will also be damaged upon contact.
description.zh_cn: 让宝可梦携带后，在受到打击招式攻击时，能给予对手伤害。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will float in the air until hit. Once hit, this item will burst.
description.zh_cn: 让宝可梦携带后，宝可梦会浮在空中。受到攻击就会破裂。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder is hit by an attack, the attacker is removed from battle.
description.zh_cn: 有着神奇力量的卡片。携带后，能让使用了招式的对手退场。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Moves that normally have no effect will land on a Pokémon holding it.
description.zh_cn: 原本因宝可梦的属性相克关系而无效的招式现在会变得能够击中自己。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A band that increases the power of binding moves used by the holder.
description.zh_cn: 能增强绑紧招式的束带。携带后，绑紧招式的威力会变强。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Atk if hit with a Water-type attack. It can only be used once.
description.zh_cn: 一次性使用的球根。携带它的宝可梦如果受到水属性招式的攻击，特攻就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Attack if hit with an Electric-type attack. It can only be used once.
description.zh_cn: 一次性使用的充电电池。携带它的宝可梦如果受到电属性招式的攻击，攻击就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is hit by an attack, it will be switched out of battle.
description.zh_cn: 携带它的宝可梦如果受到招式攻击，就能逃脱战斗，并和同行的其他宝可梦进行替换。

description.en: A gem with an essence of fire. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fire-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 火属性的宝石。携带后，火属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an essence of water. When held, it strengthens the power of a Water-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 水属性的宝石。携带后，水属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an essence of electricity. When held, it strengthens the power of an Electric-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 电属性的宝石。携带后，电属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an essence of nature. When held, it strengthens the power of a Grass-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 草属性的宝石。携带后，草属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an essence of ice. When held, it strengthens the power of an Ice-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 冰属性的宝石。携带后，冰属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an essence of combat. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fighting-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 格斗属性的宝石。携带后，格斗属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an essence of poison. When held, it strengthens the power of a Poison-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 毒属性的宝石。携带后，毒属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an essence of land. When held, it strengthens the power of a Ground-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 地面属性的宝石。携带后，地面属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an essence of air. When held, it strengthens the power of a Flying-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 飞行属性的宝石。携带后，飞行属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an essence of the mind. When held, it strengthens the power of a Psychic-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 超能力属性的宝石。携带后，超能力属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an insect-like essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Bug-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 虫属性的宝石。携带后，虫属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: A gem with an essence of rock. When held, it strengthens the power of a Rock-type move one time.
description.zh_cn: 岩石属性的宝石。携带后，岩石属性的招式威力仅会增强１次。

description.en: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.
description.zh_cn: 让电流覆盖全身撞向对手进行攻击。自己也会受到少许伤害。

description.en: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
description.zh_cn: 利用大浪攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。

description.en: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stat of opposing Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 没完没了地大声斥责，从而降低对手的特攻。

description.zh_cn: 带摄像头功能，最多能让４人进行通话的最新型对讲机。

description.en: A rare stone.
description.zh_cn: 奇幻之石。

description.zh_cn: 长翅鸥投递的重要信件。

description.zh_cn: 可以放入获得的奖牌，并记录奖牌信息的箱形机器。

description.en: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokémon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.
description.zh_cn: 据说是能让原本为一体的酋雷姆和某宝可梦合体的一对楔子。

description.en: A splicer that separates Kyurem and a certain Pokémon when they have been fused.
description.zh_cn: 能让合体后的酋雷姆和某宝可梦分离成原状的一对楔子。

description.en: A permit that is needed to enter the Nature Preserve. Not many know about it.
description.zh_cn: 只有极少数人才知道的，进入自然保护区所需的授权卡。

description.en: An oval charm said to increase the chance of Pokémon Eggs being found at the Nursery.
description.zh_cn: 拥有它之后，在寄放屋里会更容易找到蛋的神奇浑圆护符。

description.en: A shiny charm said to increase the chance of finding a Shiny Pokémon in the wild.
description.zh_cn: 拥有它之后，据说会更容易遇见发光宝可梦的神奇闪光护符。

description.en: A card key needed to enter the password inside the Plasma Frigate.
description.zh_cn: 在等离子驱逐舰的船内输入密码时，需要用到的钥匙卡。

description.en: A handkerchief dropped by a regular at Café Warehouse. It smells faintly like a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 七宝市仓库咖啡馆的熟客遗失的手帕。隐约有着宝可梦的香气。

description.en: A special device that wrings out the potential of Pokémon. It's an imperfect prototype.
description.zh_cn: 能强行让宝可梦的能力觉醒的特殊装置。但由于是试制品，功能尚未完善。

description.en: The Xtransceiver found at the Nimbasa City amusement park. It seems it belongs to a boy.
description.zh_cn: 在雷文市的游乐园里捡到的即时通讯器。失主好像是个男孩子。

description.en: The Xtransceiver found at the Nimbasa City amusement park. It seems it belongs to a girl.

description.en: A looking glass that reveals the truth. It's a mysterious glass that returns a Pokémon to its original shape.
description.zh_cn: 能够通过照出真实，让宝可梦变回原来样子的神奇镜子。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Attack and Sp. Atk sharply increase if the holder is hit with a move it's weak to.
description.zh_cn: 被针对弱点时，攻击和特攻就会大幅提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This offensive vest raises Sp. Def but prevents the use of status moves.
description.zh_cn: 会变得富有攻击性的背心。虽然携带后特防会提高，但会无法使出变化招式。

description.en: A device that allows users to receive and view hologram clips at any time. It's also used to chat with others.
description.zh_cn: 可以随时查看接收到的全息影像数据的装置。

description.en: A letter that Professor Sycamore wrote to your mother. A faint but pleasant perfume seems to cling to the paper.
description.zh_cn: 布拉塔诺博士写给妈妈的信。上面带有微微的香气。

description.en: Attaches roller skates to the bottom of your shoes, allowing you to glide quickly around and perform tricks.
description.zh_cn: 鞋底下装着滑轮。能在地面上滑行，或漂亮地表演特技。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fairy-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 妖精属性的石板。携带后，妖精属性的招式威力就会增强。

description.en: A capsule that allows a Pokémon with two Abilities to switch between these Abilities when it is used.
description.zh_cn: 如果用于有着２种特性的宝可梦，就能令其现有特性变为另一种的胶囊。

description.en: A soft and sweet treat made of fluffy, puffy, whipped, and whirled cream. It's loved by a certain Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 松松软软起着泡的，稍微有点甜的奶油。某种宝可梦很喜欢它。

description.en: A sachet filled with fragrant perfumes that are just slightly too overwhelming. Yet it's loved by a certain Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 装着散发微浓香气的香料的袋子。某种宝可梦很喜欢它。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Def if hit with a Water-type attack. It can only be used once.
description.zh_cn: 一次性使用的光苔。携带它的宝可梦如果受到水属性招式攻击，特防就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Attack if hit with an Ice-type attack. It can only be used once.
description.zh_cn: 一次性使用的雪球。携带它的宝可梦如果受到冰属性招式攻击，攻击就会提高。

description.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These goggles protect the holder from both weather-related damage and powder.
description.zh_cn: 不单是天气造成的伤害，就连粉末类招式的效果也能防御的护目镜。

description.en: A flute that can play with such a beautiful tone that even sleeping Pokémon find themselves roused.
description.zh_cn: 能吹出让睡着的宝可梦都会情不自禁醒来的美妙音色的笛子。

description.en: A bag to carry ingredients gathered during Mallow's trial in the jungle.
description.zh_cn: 将丛林里收集到的材料装在一起的袋子。在玛奥的考验中使用。

description.en: A fishing rod made by Captain Lana. Cast a line over piles of underwater rocks to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 水莲队长制作的钓竿。如果向着岩石阴影那边使用，就能钓到宝可梦。

description.en: The mask that belongs to The Masked Royal.  This pro wrestler apparently sews his mask on a machine himself.
description.zh_cn: 皇家蒙面人的面罩。好像是职业摔角手自己用缝纫机缝制的。

description.en: A ticket that allows you to host a mission in Festival Plaza.
description.zh_cn: 可以在圆庆广场开启游乐项目。

description.en: A stone entrusted by a Pokémon that has been venerated as a guardian deity in the Alola region. There is said to be some secret in how it sparkles.
description.zh_cn: 从被认为是阿罗拉守护神的宝可梦那里得到的石头。据说其光辉下有着某种秘密。

description.en: Using it makes wild Pokémon call for help a number of times. If held by a Pokémon, it boosts Speed when intimidated. It can be used only once.
description.zh_cn: 使用后可以一直呼唤伙伴，但使用后会消失。携带后，在受到威吓时速度会提高。

description.en: An item to store Zygarde Cores and Cells. You can also use it to teach Zygarde moves.

description.en: A special Poké Ball designed to catch Ultra Beasts. It has a low success rate for catching others.

description.zh_cn: 阿罗拉特产的油炸面包。能治愈１只宝可梦的所有异常状态。

description.en: A flower nectar obtained at Poni Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.

description.en: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokémon of the sun.
